caption: The video captures a small perforated metal container against a pure black background, its mesh glowing warm orange from fire burning inside and on top. A dark charred fuel piece rests on the flat rim while bright yellow-white flames lick across it and throw tongues upward and toward the upper left. The flame body continuously flickers, rising tall and narrow at times, then flattening and stretching sideways as detached wisps break from the main mass. Small flame wisps appear and vanish near the left edge, stretching slightly outward before dissolving into darkness. The white-hot core over the fuel shifts shape and brightness as fire wraps around the dark sliver, which remains in place during the burning. Below, glowing dots through the container's perforations vary with fluctuating light, keeping the metal basket visible against the void. The camera and container appear fixed, leaving only restless burning, changing lean, and intermittent shedding of flame.
relations: Flame body flickers, rising tall then flattening sideways, while the charred fuel piece remains fixed on the rim.
Detached wisps break from the main mass, stretching outward near the left edge before dissolving into darkness.
The white-hot core shifts shape and brightness as fire wraps around the stationary dark sliver.
Glowing dots through the container's perforations vary with fluctuating light, maintaining the metal basket's visibility.
